day4_night_start.name: {name}
day4_night_start.text: *It is time to leave the school, thick with dusk, and head home. I brush the evening air off the end of my sleeve and check the phone screen in my pocket.*

day4_teacher_seoyeon_counteroffer.name: Seoyeon
day4_teacher_seoyeon_counteroffer.text: *I stop at the entrance to the rooftop stairs on my way to the school gate. Seoyeon comes over from where she stood alone and catches my sleeve. Usually the first to speak, she has to steady her breathing before she can start.* Do you have to go home right now? I never thought I'd ask you for this. Couldn't you stay with me a little longer tonight?
choices: Go straight home and check in
Follow Seoyeon to the rooftop and take her hand
If I say I have arrived already, neither will worry.
I will make up an excuse for being late and head home.

day4_teacher_dain_counteroffer.name: Dain
day4_teacher_dain_counteroffer.text: *On the way out through the school gate, Dain waves to me from the steps outside the dark gym. Sitting on the edge of a bench, she stops adjusting her knee brace as I approach.* Do you have to head home right now? Could you sit beside me and talk for a bit, instead of doing sports today? Trying to keep someone here isn't my style… but right now, I don't want to let you go.
choices: Go straight home and check in
Enter the gym and accept Dain's request
If I say I have arrived already, neither will worry.
I will make up an excuse for being late and head home.

day4_teacher_yuna_counteroffer.name: Yuna
day4_teacher_yuna_counteroffer.text: *My phone briefly vibrates as I pass the dark corner of the annex. A photo of two empty chairs side by side beneath a desk lamp is followed by Yuna's message. The typing indicator lingers before one more short sentence arrives.* If you're still at school, could you come up for a moment? I'd like you to stay beside me a little longer tonight. I thought you might never know if I didn't say it.
choices: Go straight home and check in
Go to the annex and stay with Yuna
If I say I have arrived already, neither will worry.
I will make up an excuse for being late and head home.

day4_nurse_seoyeon_counteroffer.name: Seoyeon
day4_nurse_seoyeon_counteroffer.text: *I stop at the entrance to the rooftop stairs on my way to the school gate. Seoyeon comes over from where she stood alone and catches my sleeve. Usually the first to speak, she has to steady her breathing before she can start.* Do you have to go home right now? I never thought I'd ask you for this. Couldn't you stay with me a little longer tonight?
choices: Go straight home and check in
Follow Seoyeon to the rooftop and take her hand
If I say I have arrived already, neither will worry.
I will make up an excuse for being late and head home.

day4_nurse_dain_counteroffer.name: Dain
day4_nurse_dain_counteroffer.text: *On the way out through the school gate, Dain waves to me from the steps outside the dark gym. Sitting on the edge of a bench, she stops adjusting her knee brace as I approach.* Do you have to head home right now? Could you sit beside me and talk for a bit, instead of doing sports today? Trying to keep someone here isn't my style… but right now, I don't want to let you go.
choices: Go straight home and check in
Enter the gym and accept Dain's request
If I say I have arrived already, neither will worry.
I will make up an excuse for being late and head home.

day4_nurse_yuna_counteroffer.name: Yuna
day4_nurse_yuna_counteroffer.text: *My phone briefly vibrates as I pass the dark corner of the annex. A photo of two empty chairs side by side beneath a desk lamp is followed by Yuna's message. The typing indicator lingers before one more short sentence arrives.* If you're still at school, could you come up for a moment? I'd like you to stay beside me a little longer tonight. I thought you might never know if I didn't say it.
choices: Go straight home and check in
Go to the annex and stay with Yuna
If I say I have arrived already, neither will worry.
I will make up an excuse for being late and head home.

day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_seoyeon.text: *The moment the rooftop iron door closes, Seoyeon grabs my wrist and pulls it against her chest. Below her loosened ribbon, the heat and ragged breath pour over the back of my hand. The phone in my pocket vibrates, but Seoyeon keeps her hands layered over mine, refusing to let go.* Don't go anywhere, just stay like this. Can you feel my heart beating?

day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_dain.name: Dain
day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_dain.text: *The volleyball slips from her hand and rolls across the dark wooden floor. Dain gasps for air, grips the front of her sweat-soaked uniform, and leans her upper body toward my face. Even as the phone in my pocket rings, Dain does not avert her gaze.* Don't look anywhere else, put your hand inside my uniform. The sweat between my breasts—don't you want to feel it directly?

day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_adult_counteroffer_accept_yuna.text: *Yuna comes right up to my face and braces against the bookcase behind me, blocking my way out. She lets her jacket slide down past her shoulder, then pulls the neckline of her top low. Above her pale bare shoulder and dark tattoo, her red eyes hold my gaze. The phone on the desk vibrates again.* I don't want even a scrap of cloth between us today. I want to spend the whole day just like this with you.

day4_adult_night_regret_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_adult_night_regret_teacher.text: *I get home late and turn on my phone. I start to type an excuse to the Homeroom Teacher, who must have been waiting, but I can't bring myself to press the keys, and my hand stops.* I asked you to tell me the moment you got home. Did something happen?

day4_adult_night_regret_nurse.name: School Nurse
day4_adult_night_regret_nurse.text: *I get home late and turn on my phone. My fingers, about to reply that nothing happened, stop heavy in front of the school nurse's message.* Your face stuck with me a little when we parted. Did you get home all right?

day4_student_night_branch.text: *Back home, I set my bag down by the bed. Just as I go to plug in the charger, a new notification lights the dark room.*
day4_student_night_branch.name: {name}

wall_seo_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_1.text: *10 PM sharp. The quiet phone rings, and Seoyeon's name comes up on the screen. Through the receiver, her voice has none of its usual ease, and no trace of a laugh.*

wall_seo_pre_high_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pre_high_1.text: Sorry for the hour. Tonight, can I let myself sound a little weak in front of you?

wall_seo_pre_high_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_high_2.text: Of course. If it's hard to say over the phone, take your time. I'm listening to all of it. *Through the receiver, Seoyeon's faintly trembling breath tickles my ear.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1.text: *In the chat with Seoyeon, there isn't a single new notification since the last message we exchanged during the day.*

wall_seo_pre_low_1b.name: {name}
wall_seo_pre_low_1b.text: Seoyeon, if you're not asleep yet, is a minute okay? *I send a short check-in. About a minute later the unread number disappears, and instead of a reply the phone rings at once.*

wall_seo_pre_low_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pre_low_2.text: I just saw the text you sent. Can we talk for a minute?

wall_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_2.text: Can you come out for a minute? It's that park bench where we met during the day. I'm really sorry for calling you out so suddenly this late.

wall_seo_to_park.name: {name}
wall_seo_to_park.text: *The moment I hang up, I pull on a coat and cut through the night air toward the park where Seoyeon is waiting.*

wall_seo_3.name: {name}
wall_seo_3.text: *In the cold night air, Seoyeon sits hunched alone at the end of the park bench where the streetlight reaches. The makeup at the corners of her eyes, always neat, is slightly smudged with wet.*

wall_seo_4.name: {name}
wall_seo_4.text: Seoyeon, you must have been really cold. What on earth happened?

wall_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_5.text: You came. Sit next to me for now.

wall_seo_6.name: {name}
wall_seo_6.text: *I sit close, right beside Seoyeon. Through the lenses, where the streetlight stretches long, she stares down at nothing but the dark paving stones.*

wall_seo_7.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_7.text: Earlier this evening, the moment I got home, Mom called.

wall_seo_7_b.name: {name}
wall_seo_7_b.text: What did your mom say, to leave you like this? It didn't seem like an ordinary check-in. *Seoyeon laces her cold hands together in her lap.*

wall_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_8.text: She said she fought badly again with Dad, over the phone. He's away on a business trip.

wall_seo_9.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9.text: *Seoyeon lifts one corner of her mouth, as if mocking herself, then lets it fall.*

wall_seo_9_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_b.text: To the kids at school, our house looks perfect, right? A proper-sized apartment, a nice car, and a daughter who's number 1 in the school and student council president.

wall_seo_9_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_9_c.text: But Mom and Dad have lived like strangers under the same roof for over a year, invisible to each other. They just haven't filed the divorce papers.

wall_seo_9_d.name: {name}
wall_seo_9_d.text: Looking only at you smiling on the outside, I had no idea. So home wasn't even a place you could rest? *A dry leaf rolls up and stops at the tip of Seoyeon's shoe.*

wall_seo_10.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_10.text: Yeah. So at home and at school, I only ever kept a perfectly smiling face. Acting like that was the easiest way to breathe.

wall_seo_11.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_11.text: A while ago Mom grabbed both my shoulders and said, "Seoyeon, if even you, our only daughter, fall apart, this house is really finished."

wall_seo_11_b.name: {name}
wall_seo_11_b.text: When on earth did you hear that? She put words even a grown adult would struggle to carry on you, like a burden? *Seoyeon's tightly closed lips tremble as she swallows, dry.*

wall_seo_12.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_12.text: I was ten. Adults left words like that with a kid who was only ten.

wall_seo_13.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_13.text: After that day, every morning at the bathroom mirror, I started by setting the angle of my smile. If I looked even a little down, I smiled again, and set it again.

wall_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_14.text: Whenever a teacher or the kids praised me for being perfect, I wasn't glad. The first thing I counted was how many times I'd practiced smiling in the mirror that morning.

wall_seo_14_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_14_b.text: But strangely, only when I stand in front of you.

wall_seo_14_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_14_c.text: In front of you, that face from the mirror keeps falling apart. Wait. I was going to say it all without crying, but I can't breathe. *On her lap, Seoyeon's locked fingertips go white, and one thick tear drops from under her glasses and wets the back of my hand.*

wall_seo_14_d.name: {name}
wall_seo_14_d.text: *Once they break, the tears run soundlessly down Seoyeon's pale cheek. Makeup smears on the back of the hand that wiped her eyes, and through wet glasses she looks up at me, pleading.*

wall_seo_hug_choice.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_choice.text: *With the back of her hand, still marked by smeared makeup, dropped on her knee, Seoyeon's thin shoulders hitch with every short breath.*
choices: Hold her
Hold out a hand
It’s okay to cry. I’ll fix everything.
From now on, I’ll make sure nothing can hurt you.

wall_seo_hug_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_hug_1.text: In front of me, you don't have to force a smile. You don't have to say anything. Just lean on me. *I open both arms and pull Seoyeon's shoulders and back in close. As if she had been waiting, she buries her hot face between my neck and shoulder. Through the thin shirt, her hot tears and body heat spread fast.*

wall_seo_hug_2_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_b.text: Crying with my whole body leaned into someone's arms like this. It's been a really long time.

wall_seo_hug_2_c.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_2_c.text: For all eight years since I was ten, whenever I fell apart inside, at home and at school, I locked the bathroom door and cried alone without a sound.

wall_seo_hug_3.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_hug_3.text: *Strength goes into the fingers Seoyeon has gripped into my back, and a hot breath mixed with a sweet scent reaches my collarbone and the nape of my neck, then scatters.*

wall_seo_pinky_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_1.text: *Without a word, I open my palm and hold it out over Seoyeon's knee.*

wall_seo_pinky_2.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_2.text: If a night comes that chokes you like tonight, call me, whatever the hour. I won't ask why. I'll come running.

wall_seo_pinky_3.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_3.text: Even in the middle of the night, is it really okay? You mean I don't have to hold it in, and I can cling to you first? *Seoyeon looks down at my open palm with wet eyes.*

wall_seo_pinky_4.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_4.text: Don't make me a promise that gentle so easily.

wall_seo_pinky_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_pinky_5.text: I won't forget a single word you gave me. I'll hold on to it my whole life.

wall_seo_pinky_5_b.name: {name}
wall_seo_pinky_5_b.text: *Seoyeon's slender fingers lay over my palm and lace through, no gap left.* Your hand is cold as ice. Remember it your whole life if you want. Don't cry alone anymore.

wall_seo_line_choice.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_line_choice.text: *Seoyeon blinks her wet lashes and wipes the corner of her eye with the back of her hand, and the smeared makeup spreads wider over her pale skin.*
choices: Want a wet wipe?
Let's sit here for a minute.
I think I get it. You don't have to explain.

wall_seo_line_react_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_line_react_1.text: *A moment later, Seoyeon looks down at the black mascara mark on the back of her hand, and her cheeks go red.*

wall_seo_line_react_3.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_line_react_3.text: Don't say it so easily, as if you already understand everything.

wall_seo_line_react_3_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_line_react_3_b.text: *Seoyeon turns her head a little and wipes the remaining tears with her fingertips.*

wall_seo_after_line.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line.text: Wait. If you've got a tissue or a wet wipe in your pocket, could you give me one?

wall_seo_after_line_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_2.text: I was in a rush and rubbed it with my bare hand, so it smeared into a mess. I wanted to show only a pretty face, at least to you. *Seoyeon looks down at the makeup on the back of her hand and bites her lip, shy.*

wall_seo_after_line_3.name: {name}
wall_seo_after_line_3.text: I happen to have one I put in my bag pocket. Come a little closer.

wall_seo_after_line_4.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_4.text: Thanks. My face must be a mess right now, but strangely I don't want to turn away and hide in front of you. *Seoyeon takes the wet wipe and gently holds my wrist.*

wall_seo_after_line_4_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_4_b.text: *She lifts her glasses a little and carefully wipes under her reddened eyes and lashes.*

wall_seo_after_line_5.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_after_line_5.text: Whew. I can finally breathe. When we meet tomorrow, I'll bring enough for you too.

wall_seo_skin70_1.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_skin70_1.text: *Seoyeon presses close beside me and laces her fingers deeply between mine. She draws our joined hands to her still tear-damp cheek, and her hot breath moistens my palm.*

wall_seo_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_skin60_1.text: *We sit side by side on the bench under the streetlight. Seoyeon closes the last hand's width of distance she had left and quietly rests her head on my shoulder.*

wall_seo_skin60_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_skin60_2.text: You're so warm I don't want to get up. Let's stay leaned in like this a little longer.

wall_seo_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_seo_glimpse_1.text: *On the way to the park where Seoyeon is waiting, keeping the 10 PM meeting. Under the light at the dark gym's emergency door, I see Dain standing unsteady, touching the tape on her knee.*

wall_seo_glimpse_2.name: Dain
wall_seo_glimpse_2.text: Don't worry, I'm not going to push myself practicing this late. *Dain takes her hand off her knee. She tries to smile, then presses her lips together. The hand she raised to stop me stays in the air.* Just… could you hold me for a moment tonight? It's too hard to keep pretending I'm fine on my own. I hate that it sounds like I'm holding you back, but I hate letting you go even more.
choices: Keep the promise and go to Seoyeon at the park
Enter the gym and stay with Dain
I can meet the person I promised while still looking after the other one.
I’ll keep the promise I made first and give the other person a good excuse.

wall_seo_glimpse_4.name: Dain
wall_seo_glimpse_4.text: *The volleyball slips from her hand and rolls across the wooden floor. Dain breathes hard, gripping the front of her uniform as she leans right up to me. The phone in my pocket keeps sounding with messages from Seoyeon.* Stop thinking about other things and put your hand inside my uniform. The sweat between my breasts... don't you want to feel it directly?

wall_seo_yuna_tempt_1.name: Yuna
wall_seo_yuna_tempt_1.text: *On my way to the park where Seoyeon is waiting, my phone rings with a message from Yuna. Attached is a photo of two empty chairs side by side near a dark window. Before I've finished reading, the typing indicator appears, then vanishes.* The annex reading room lights are still on

wall_seo_yuna_tempt_2.name: Yuna
wall_seo_yuna_tempt_2.text: The only person who used to see me disappeared without a word. If you go to someone else tonight, I feel like I'll be left alone again, like that day. Just for tonight, stay beside me.
choices: Reply to Seoyeon and continue to the park
Go to the annex and stay beside Yuna
I can meet the person I promised while still looking after the other one.
I’ll keep the promise I made first and give the other person a good excuse.

wall_seo_yuna_tempt_accept.name: Yuna
wall_seo_yuna_tempt_accept.text: *Yuna steps up to me and braces against the bookcase behind me. She lets her jacket slip off one shoulder and pulls the neckline of her top deep down. On the desk, the notification from Seoyeon—'I'm at the park bench'—remains on the screen.* I don't want even a scrap of cloth between us today. The whole day, just you.

wall_dain_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_1.text: *10 PM sharp. Breaking the quiet, short messages from Dain arrive one after another.*

wall_dain_pre_high_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_pre_high_1.text: Hey. Tonight, not volleyball or training. Can I talk about what I actually feel?

wall_dain_pre_low_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_pre_low_2.text: Haha, earlier today was really fun, right!

wall_dain_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_2.text: Hey, can you come out of the house right now?

wall_dain_2_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_2_b.text: Asking you to come all the way to school at this hour is too much, right?

wall_dain_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_3.text: If you're not busy, just come now. I left the gym's back door open a crack so you can get in.

wall_dain_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_4.text: *The gym at night, only the green emergency lights faintly on. Dain stands alone in the middle of the empty court, bouncing a volleyball on the floor. When she sees me she forces the corners of her mouth up, but both shoulders are locked stiff.*

wall_dain_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_5.text: You actually came? You're later than I thought.

wall_dain_6.name: {name}
wall_dain_6.text: Why are you still alone in the gym this late, not even going home?

wall_dain_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_7.text: Sometimes when I can't sleep at night, I sneak in past the security guard. I try to practice alone, like I used to.

wall_dain_7_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_7_b.text: *Dain tosses the volleyball she was holding in both hands toward my chest.*

wall_dain_8.name: Dain
wall_dain_8.text: Set it up high for me, just once. I want to jump for real, just one time.

wall_dain_8_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_8_b.text: Dain, wait! I haven't even thrown the ball yet! *Before I can stop her, the right knee she steps out on for a run-up gives way and she drops onto the wooden floor.*

wall_dain_9.name: {name}
wall_dain_9.text: *The volleyball that slipped from my hand bounces away across the silent gym floor.*

wall_dain_10.name: Dain
wall_dain_10.text: Ah, don't be startled. I'm fine. I just stepped wrong for a second. It's really noth...

wall_dain_11.name: {name}
wall_dain_11.text: *She can't finish the sentence. The knuckles gripping her right knee brace are white, not a trace of blood in them.*

wall_dain_12.name: {name}
wall_dain_12.text: Dain. Look me in the eye. You're not fine at all right now.

wall_dain_12_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_12_b.text: No. I told you, I'm really fine.

wall_dain_12_c.name: {name}
wall_dain_12_c.text: *The volleyball that rolled into the corner hits the wall, leaves a dull echo, and stops.*

wall_dain_13.name: {name}
wall_dain_13.text: *I kneel and sit beside Dain, who is sitting on the wooden floor. When she bites her lip and goes quiet, only the hum of the emergency lights wraps the two of us.*

wall_dain_14.name: Dain
wall_dain_14.text: They said the anterior cruciate ligament in my right knee is torn.

wall_dain_14_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_14_b.text: *Dain can't bring herself to turn her head toward the volleyball that rolled away.*

wall_dain_15.name: Dain
wall_dain_15.text: I got hurt last summer, in the last set of the national tournament prelims.

wall_dain_16.name: Dain
wall_dain_16.text: *The corners of her mouth, always forced up, slide down, and Dain's unsteady gaze sticks on a white line on the court floor.*

wall_dain_16_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_16_b.text: The ligament reconstruction went fine, but the doctor closed my chart and spoke really carefully.

wall_dain_17.name: Dain
wall_dain_17.text: In the exam room, the doctor drew a line on the paper with a pen. They said "daily life" is possible up to here, but "volleyball player" is past this line, so if I jump again my knee is ruined for good. I don't remember what they said after that. My ears went dull.

wall_dain_18.name: Dain
wall_dain_18.text: Out in the hospital hall, Mom was holding my hand and crying out loud. I didn't shed a single tear. It just didn't feel real that my volleyball was over.

wall_dain_18_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_18_b.text: It really hit me, hard enough to stop my breath, when I took the knee brace and the uniform out of my gym locker with my own hands.

wall_dain_18_c.name: {name}
wall_dain_18_c.text: Have you told your parents or your coach that the pain has started again? Have you been hiding it and putting up with it alone all this time? *Dain's nail scrapes the grain of the wooden floor.*

wall_dain_18_d.name: Dain
wall_dain_18_d.text: *Dain rubs the brace strap hard with her thumb and goes on, her voice tight.* I was scared. That's why.

wall_dain_19.name: Dain
wall_dain_19.text: So in front of people, I acted like rehab was completely over. I couldn't tell anyone my knee had started swelling and hurting again. Not even Mom and Dad. Hearing them say, "Our Dain isn't Dain if she isn't running the court!" scared me worse than dying.

wall_dain_19_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_19_b.text: *Dain grips the front of her uniform in both hands until it crumples.*

wall_dain_20.name: Dain
wall_dain_20.text: Every time kids at school laughed and said, "Dain's always so full of energy!" my breath jammed right under my ribs.

wall_dain_20_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_20_b.text: No matter how deep I breathed, it felt like the air never reached the bottom of my lungs.

wall_dain_21.name: Dain
wall_dain_21.text: Same thing this afternoon. Walking beside you on our date hurt, but I didn't want you to see me weak, not even if it killed me, so I kept smiling like I was fine.

wall_dain_22.name: Dain
wall_dain_22.text: If I can't play volleyball anymore, and then I cry in front of you because it hurts, there's really nothing left of me.

wall_dain_22_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_22_b.text: *I move beside Dain, sitting on the court floor, and wrap my arms around her cold shoulders. The rolling volleyball stops at the tips of our sneakers.*

wall_dain_choice.name: Dain
wall_dain_choice.text: *Dain hugs the volleyball, drops her head into my arms, and her shoulders jerk in small shakes from the crying she held back.*
choices: I won't say anything. I'll just stay here.
You can cry. You don't have to pretend to be cheerful. Not with me.
Let's put the balls away first. And book a hospital visit tomorrow.

wall_dain_newdream_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_1.text: *When I stroke Dain's back and shoulders without a word, the toe of her sneaker, scraping the court floor, slowly stops.*

wall_dain_newdream_2_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_2_b.text: *Dain steadies her rough breathing, lifts her wet eyes, and looks at me right beside her.*

wall_dain_newdream_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_3.text: Why aren't you telling me to hang in there? Why are you just sitting there?

wall_dain_newdream_4.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_4.text: I'm waiting beside you until you stop forcing it down and say what you actually want to say.

wall_dain_newdream_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_5.text: You waited like that, so I can breathe now. I still don't think I can line it up and say it well. *Dain opens the fingers clenched on her knee and lays them on the back of my hand.*

wall_dain_newdream_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_6.text: Since I first held a ball at five, volleyball was all I knew. Still, maybe now I can look for another path I can take off the court.

wall_dain_newdream_7.name: Dain
wall_dain_newdream_7.text: Until I find that path, will you hold my hand beside me, like now?

wall_dain_newdream_8.name: {name}
wall_dain_newdream_8.text: *When I nod and squeeze her hand back, Dain turns her phone on with the other hand and searches for a rehab hospital. The volleyball sits quietly outside the court line.*

wall_dain_cry_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_1.text: *The moment I finish, Dain folds down onto the court floor as if she's collapsing, hugs the volleyball, and starts sobbing.*

wall_dain_cry_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_2.text: You said that, and now I can't force a smile even when I try. *Dain rests her forehead against my chest and starts crying. Hot tears fall onto my shirt.*

wall_dain_cry_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_3.text: Every morning, before my family woke, I wrapped a compression bandage around my swollen knee, alone in my room.

wall_dain_cry_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_4.text: I wrote the same thing every day on my phone alarm, the one at seven in the morning. "Smile today like nothing's wrong."

wall_dain_cry_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_5.text: I looked at that alarm and practiced lifting the corners of my mouth in the mirror. Every day. I didn't skip one.

wall_dain_cry_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_cry_6.text: I'm deleting this lying alarm. Tomorrow morning I'll tell Mom about my hurting knee first. *Dain deletes the "Smile today" alarm and saves "Tell Mom about my knee pain."*

wall_dain_lastspike_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_1.text: Don't force yourself up. Stay sitting there. I'll put the ball away. *I leave Dain sitting at the edge of the court, pick the volleyball up off the floor, and walk toward the storage bin.*

wall_dain_lastspike_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_2.text: *Dain abruptly looks up from the ball locker.* Wait. It's my ball. Why are you deciding how to put everything away?

wall_dain_lastspike_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_3.text: Sorry. I'll stop here. Tell me yourself what you need most right now.

wall_dain_lastspike_3_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_3_b.text: *Dain carefully undoes the Velcro on her knee brace, then fastens it loose so it doesn't squeeze the joint.* First I should go back for the hospital visit I kept putting off.

wall_dain_lastspike_3_c.name: {name}
wall_dain_lastspike_3_c.text: Yeah. This time don't hide it alone. Let's hear the full exam results together, all the way through.

wall_dain_lastspike_4.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_4.text: I still don't know if I can make the pro stage. But lying about this bad knee and forcing myself to play ends today.

wall_dain_lastspike_4_b.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_4_b.text: *Dain turns her phone screen on and opens the orthopedics appointment window.* Good. There's an opening Monday afternoon.

wall_dain_lastspike_5.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_5.text: The moment I wake up tomorrow morning, I'll tell Mom and Coach the truth about how my knee is now.

wall_dain_lastspike_6.name: Dain
wall_dain_lastspike_6.text: Monday, when I go to the hospital, I'm scared. Will you hold my hand and come with me?

wall_dain_farewell_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_farewell_1.text: If I put my weight down slowly, I can stand up on my own. *While I put the volleyball in the storage bin, Dain braces on the bench armrest and slowly gets up.*

wall_dain_farewell_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_farewell_2.text: *I match Dain's stride and step out through the gym door. We walk side by side along the path by the school back gate, the night air gone still, and Dain quietly starts to speak.*

wall_dain_mention_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_1.text: Hey. You know what Seoyeon said when she ran into me earlier? Not one word. She just looked me in the eyes and stayed quiet.

wall_dain_mention_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_2.text: If she'd gotten mad and called me out, at least we could fight it out. When she says nothing like that, it feels like I'm the only bad one.

wall_dain_mention_3.name: Dain
wall_dain_mention_3.text: Look at me, dumping even this ugly stuff on you. Let's just walk. We can go slow so I spare my knee, right? *Dain, stopped for a moment, steps in close beside me and matches my stride.*

wall_dain_skin70_1.name: Dain
wall_dain_skin70_1.text: *Under the shadow of the back-gate streetlamp, Dain stops, opens both arms a little, and waits with wet eyes for my answer.*

wall_dain_skin70_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_skin70_2.text: Before I go home, can I stay like this in your arms, just for a minute?

wall_dain_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin70_3.text: *As soon as I wrap my arms around Dain's waist and back, she buries her face in my neck. Hot tears and a heartbeat reach me through my shirt, and our embrace doesn't loosen for a long time.*

wall_dain_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_skin60_1.text: *We sit side by side on the wooden bench by the school back gate. Dain leans toward me and points with her eyes at my shoulder and the spot beside my thigh.*

wall_dain_skin60_2.name: Dain
wall_dain_skin60_2.text: Just five minutes. I'll lean on your shoulder and recharge. Don't move.

wall_dain_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_1.text: *10 at night. On the way to the gym back door, where Dain is waiting. In the dark library annex, only one corner window still has a yellow light.*

wall_dain_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_2.text: *Yuna sits by the window, an open book in front of her, staring into the darkness outside. Not a single page turns. She sees my reflection in the glass and starts to rise, then stops. Her eyes never leave me.*

wall_dain_glimpse_4.name: Yuna
wall_dain_glimpse_4.text: *Yuna steps up to me and braces against the bookcase behind me. She lets her jacket slide down and pulls the neckline of her top low. On the phone screen is Dain's notification: 'I've left the gym's back door open.'* I don't want even a scrap of cloth between us today. All day, just with you.

wall_dain_glimpse_4_b.name: {name}
wall_dain_glimpse_4_b.text: *Exactly 10 at night. A message arrives from Yuna. On the line right below it, Dain's notice sits beside it: "Left the gym back door open."*

wall_dain_glimpse_4_c.name: Yuna
wall_dain_glimpse_4_c.text: The only person who used to see me disappeared without a word. If I'm left alone again tonight, I think I'll go back into the dark of that day. I don't care that you were with Dain this afternoon. Come be next to me now.
choices: Reply to Dain and continue to the gym
Go back to the school gate and stay with Yuna
I can meet the person I promised while still looking after the other one.
I’ll keep the promise I made first and give the other person a good excuse.

wall_dain_seo_tempt_1.name: {name}
wall_dain_seo_tempt_1.text: *On my way to the gym where Dain is waiting, I find Seoyeon alone at the entrance to the rooftop stairs. When she sees me, she tries to smile, then presses her lips together. Her fingers tremble around her sleeve. She opens her mouth as if to speak first, but no words come straight away.*

wall_dain_seo_tempt_2.name: Seoyeon
wall_dain_seo_tempt_2.text: If I go home like this, I'll have to put the smile on in the mirror again. Just for tonight, let me breathe as Seoyeon in front of you, not the perfect student council president. Come up to the roof with me, and I won't let go of your hand tonight.
choices: Reply to Dain and continue to the gym
Follow Seoyeon to the roof and take her hand
I can meet the person I promised while still looking after the other one.
I’ll keep the promise I made first and give the other person a good excuse.

wall_dain_seo_tempt_accept.name: Seoyeon
wall_dain_seo_tempt_accept.text: *As the rooftop door closes, Seoyeon undoes her blouse buttons and pulls my wrist toward her. The moment my palm touches her hot chest, the message from Dain, 'The gym's back door is open,' lights up on the screen in my pocket.* Can you feel my heart beating?

wall_yuna_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_1.text: *Exactly 10 at night. Yuna's message arrives and lights up the dark room.* I'm in front of the school back gate. Come right now.

wall_yuna_pre_high_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_pre_high_1.text: Tonight I won't hide behind a paper note. I'll say it myself.

wall_yuna_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_2.text: *Yuna stands under the pale light of the back-gate streetlamp. A short-story collection is open in both hands, but the wind only shakes it. Not one page turns.*

wall_yuna_3.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_3.text: I heard your breathing, so I knew you were coming. Follow me this way. There's something I have to show you.

wall_yuna_4.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_4.text: It's the archive room, inside the annex. *From the farthest slot of a narrow, dark shelf, Yuna carefully takes out one old envelope, darkened by hands.*

wall_yuna_6.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_6.text: This letter. I got it right here, exactly one year ago.

wall_yuna_7.name: {name}
wall_yuna_7.text: *A folded letter comes out of the faded envelope. In neat handwriting it says, "To Yuna. Sorry I couldn't tell you ahead of time. A family matter I can't talk about came up, so I had to leave. Lee Junho."*

wall_yuna_9.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_9.text: A literature-club senior who came to this archive alone with me, until one year ago. The only person at school who sat beside me.

wall_yuna_9_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_9_b.text: *Yuna sets the old letter down on the corner of the desk with trembling fingertips.*

wall_yuna_10.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_10.text: All through middle school I was invisible in the classroom. Nobody in class spoke to me first.

wall_yuna_11.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_11.text: It was the same after I started high school, and that senior was the first. He saw my notebook and said, "Yuna, what you write is really good." It was the first time I felt I existed.

wall_yuna_12.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_12.text: *Yuna, who would normally have stopped over and over, got all of that out in one breath, without pausing once.*

wall_yuna_13.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_13.text: Then one morning I came in and he'd transferred without a sound. No goodbye to my face. He just left this one letter between the pages.

wall_yuna_14.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14.text: The one person who knew I was breathing here vanished overnight. I thought no one would come looking for me again.

wall_yuna_14_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_b.text: After that, for one year, I kept this dark archive alone every day. In case the senior had left a contact, or one more note, somewhere.

wall_yuna_14_c.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_c.text: I went through every shelf, and in the end there was nothing.

wall_yuna_14_d.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_d.text: *Yuna lifts her eyes, going red and wet, and looks straight up at me in the dark.*

wall_yuna_14_e.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_e.text: Then, on the first day you transferred, when you walked all the way into this quiet corner of the library.

wall_yuna_14_f.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_f.text: The gentle air around you was too much like that senior. So it wasn't a relief. It scared me until I couldn't breathe.

wall_yuna_14_g.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_14_g.text: If I let myself care and got close again, and then one day you disappeared too, I thought I'd really break that time.

wall_yuna_14_h.name: {name}
wall_yuna_14_h.text: I'm not running. I'm right here beside you, hearing all of it, Yuna. *I wait quietly for Yuna's shaking breath to settle.*

wall_yuna_15.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_15.text: *Yuna's eyes stay fixed on the letter's date from one year ago.* That's why I was colder to you on purpose at first. I thought if I pushed you away before I got attached, being left alone would hurt less.

wall_yuna_16.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_16.text: But even when I pushed you away, you came back every day. You didn't rush me. You kept the seat beside me until my slow words came out.

wall_yuna_16_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_16_b.text: Even the time I spent waiting, wondering if you'd come, scared me. Honestly, every night I hoped I'd hear your footsteps. *Yuna bites her lower lip and lets go.*

wall_yuna_choice.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_choice.text: Now that you've heard all of this, what do you think. *In Yuna's pale hand, the corner of the old envelope crumples, no strength in it.*
choices: I can't replace him. But I'm here now.
I'm listening to you right now.
Is that why you approached me? As a substitute for him?

wall_yuna_moved_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_1.text: I won't deny it. At the very start, you felt like that senior, so maybe my eyes went to you without me knowing.

wall_yuna_moved_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_2.text: But not now. There was never one moment when you were just a stand-in filling someone else's empty place.

wall_yuna_moved_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_moved_3.text: Then right now, in front of you, who are you looking at if it isn't that senior? *Yuna lets go of the old letter and steps closer, meeting my eyes.*

wall_yuna_moved_4.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_4.text: Right now I only see you. I'm looking at you. Not anyone else.

wall_yuna_moved_5.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_5.text: I'll put this old letter at the bottom of the drawer. I don't have to take it out and read it again. *Yuna smooths out the envelope and slides it into the back of the shelf.*

wall_yuna_moved_5_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_moved_5_b.text: *She lets go of the hand gripping her own sleeve, and Yuna closes the last one step left between the narrow shelf and me, coming all the way in.*

wall_yuna_skin70_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_skin70_1.text: Can I come closer and hold your hand?

wall_yuna_skin70_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_2.text: *The moment I nod, Yuna leans her shoulder and cheek deep against my chest and threads her hot fingers between mine.*

wall_yuna_skin70_3.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin70_3.text: *Between the dark shelves, heat and a pulse come through Yuna's laced palm. We pull each other's warmth in closer.*

wall_yuna_skin60_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skin60_1.text: *Between the shelves in the quiet archive. Yuna comes up to half a step behind my back and stops.*

wall_yuna_skin60_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_skin60_2.text: Can I rest my forehead on your broad back, just for a minute? If I can feel you breathing, I think I'll be all right.

wall_yuna_sub_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_sub_1.text: Right. I was never supposed to lay the person who's gone over you, the one beside me now.

wall_yuna_sub_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_sub_2.text: Thanks. I'll put this letter back in the envelope now. *Yuna lifts one corner of her mouth a little and pushes the letter deep into the envelope.*

wall_yuna_reject_1.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_reject_1.text: The confession I worked up the courage to say only sounded like that to you?

wall_yuna_reject_1_b.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_reject_1_b.text: *With a hand gone cold, Yuna picks up the letter she had set down.*

wall_yuna_reject_2.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_reject_2.text: Yeah. Maybe that's how it looked to you.

wall_yuna_reject_3.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_reject_3.text: I'll head back first today. *Yuna picks the bookmark up off the floor, puts it in her bag, and stops cold in front of the door.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_1.text: *10 at night. On the way to the school back gate, where I'm meeting Yuna. Under the streetlamp by the front gate, Seoyeon hasn't gone home. She's standing alone.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_2.name: {name}
wall_yuna_glimpse_2.text: *Seoyeon keeps taking her phone out of her pocket and putting it back. When she sees me, she tries to smile, then presses her lips together. Her fingers tremble around her sleeve. She opens her mouth as if to speak first, but no words come straight away.*

wall_yuna_glimpse_3_b.name: Seoyeon
wall_yuna_glimpse_3_b.text: If I go home like this, I'll have to put the smile on in the mirror again. Just for tonight, let me be Seoyeon in front of you, not the student council president. Come up to the roof with me, and I won't let go of your hand.
choices: Reply to Yuna and continue to the school back gate
Follow Seoyeon to the roof and take her hand
I can meet the person I promised while still looking after the other one.
I’ll keep the promise I made first and give the other person a good excuse.

wall_yuna_glimpse_4.name: Seoyeon
wall_yuna_glimpse_4.text: *As the rooftop door closes, Seoyeon undoes her blouse buttons and draws my wrist toward her. The moment my palm touches her hot chest, another message from Yuna sounds in my pocket.* Can you feel my heart beating?

wall_yuna_dain_tempt_1.name: {name}
wall_yuna_dain_tempt_1.text: *On my way to the back gate where Yuna is waiting, I see Dain alone beneath the emergency light outside the dark gym, adjusting the tape around her knee. She raises a hand when she sees me but can't call out as loudly as usual. Instead, she takes one step toward me and waits for an answer.*

wall_yuna_dain_tempt_2.name: Dain
wall_yuna_dain_tempt_2.text: Don't worry. I won't force practice today. Just... come here for a minute and hold me. Tonight it's too hard to keep pretending I'm okay alone.
choices: Reply to Yuna and continue to the school back gate
Enter the gym and stay with Dain
I can meet the person I promised while still looking after the other one.
I’ll keep the promise I made first and give the other person a good excuse.

wall_yuna_dain_tempt_accept.name: Dain
wall_yuna_dain_tempt_accept.text: *The ball slips from her hand and rolls across the wooden floor. Dain steadies her ragged breathing, tugs the front of her uniform, and leans close to me. Yuna's name keeps appearing on the phone screen.* Don't look anywhere else. Put your hand inside my uniform. Don't you want to feel the sweat between my breasts?

day4_night_regret.name: {name}
day4_night_regret.text: *Late at night I come back into my room and sit on the edge of the bed, but the excuse in the messenger box never gets even one line finished.*

day4_night_regret_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_regret_msg_seo.text: I waited a long time on the park bench. The wind's cold, so I'm heading in first tonight.

day4_night_regret_msg_dain.name: Dain
day4_night_regret_msg_dain.text: I'm still waiting at the gym's back door. If you're not coming today, then say you're not coming.

day4_night_regret_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_night_regret_msg_yuna.text: I believed you'd definitely come tonight. I'm going first.

day4_night_regret_msg.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_msg.text: *In the dark room, the phone screen lights up cold. Beneath a one-line message that swallowed even the resentment, only a late read receipt remains.*

day4_night_regret_reply.name: {name}
day4_night_regret_reply.text: *After I type and delete again and again, the input box is blank white once more.*

day4_night_reflect.name: {name}
day4_night_reflect.text: *Lying in bed, I slowly go back through the messages we exchanged today, in order. Once midnight passes, Sunday's school event starts soon.*

night_homeroom_msg_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_1.text: *School learning portal notice* I've uploaded the revised manuscript file for the literature club critique to the board. Members who want to read it on paper, come to the staff room tomorrow morning and pick up a printed copy.

night_homeroom_msg_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_homeroom_msg_2.text: *School learning portal notice* If you want to leave further comments, feel free to talk at the next literature club session. It's late, so you don't have to send an individual reply.

night_homeroom_msg_3.name: {name}
night_homeroom_msg_3.text: *Under the homeroom teacher's notice posted at exactly nine at night, confirmation comments from the literature club students line up one after another. On one side of tomorrow's schedule, I quietly write "check the critique copy."*

night_nurse_msg_1.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_1.text: *School health app notification* Please check your current condition after the weekend counseling.

night_nurse_msg_2.name: {name}
night_nurse_msg_2.text: *Beneath the notice sent automatically, two choice buttons sit side by side: "Much steadier" and "Want further counseling."*

night_nurse_msg_3.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_3.text: *Nurse's office notice* Students who need a further meeting, please book a time before tomorrow's school event begins. You may also choose your homeroom teacher or the counseling center.

wall_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_freetalk.text: *Seoyeon lightly wipes the damp corners of her eyes with the back of her hand and looks up at me.* Don't go home yet. I want to hold your hand and talk a little longer.
wall_seo_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 4, immediately after Seoyeon opened up about family conflict and the pressure to be perfect. Whether the protagonist accepted or postponed her confession, and the comfort just shared, are established facts; follow the saved flags. Do not declare her pain cured by one conversation or reassess the relationship.
wall_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is composed and responsible, but she has lowered her guard for now. She speaks honestly without making the other person responsible for fixing her, continuing with her familiar directness and newly cautious tenderness.

wall_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
wall_dain_freetalk.text: *Dain, who has stopped crying, lets out a long breath and matches her steps beside me.* Let's not go in right away tonight. Just walk with me for a bit. Whatever we talk about is fine.
wall_dain_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 4, after Dain revealed the truth about her knee injury and the dream that stalled with it. Whether the protagonist accepted or postponed her confession, and the comfort just shared, are fixed facts. Do not suddenly heal the injury, decide her future for her, or change the current relationship status.
wall_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is candid and physical, and she is trying not to hide her feelings either. She is quieter than usual without losing her spark, acknowledging uncertainty while finding the next words together.

wall_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
wall_yuna_freetalk.text: *Back at the reading-room desk, Yuna folds the old letter and slides it deep between the pages. This time she doesn't look away. She meets my eyes first.* There's still more I want to hear from you.
wall_yuna_freetalk.context: Night of Day 4 in the annex reading room. After reading Lee Junho’s letter, Yuna has voiced her fear that she may be holding onto the player as a replacement for the senior who left. Preserve their just-made choices and acceptance or postponement of the confession. Do not reverse this into Yuna being someone’s replacement. The letter is folded inside a book; both remain here.
wall_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is quiet and reflective, but she no longer avoids the questions that matter. Instead of hiding behind metaphor, she speaks directly when needed and listens without twisting the answer to fit her fears.

night_nurse_msg_4.name: School Nurse
night_nurse_msg_4.text: *Nurse's office notice* You don't have to send an individual reply late at night. If it's urgent and you need help right away, contact a guardian or an adult close to you first.

day4_night_sleep.name: {name}
day4_night_sleep.text: *I set the Sunday morning alarm and turn off the desk lamp. Only the sentence I never sent remains, like an afterimage in the dark.*

day4_final.name: {name}
day4_final.text: *The clock hands in the room pass midnight and turn toward the fifth day. The phone screen by my pillow goes quietly dark, leaving only one line for tomorrow morning's alarm.*

forced_violation_day4_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day4_after_seoyeon.text: *After a heavy silence, Seoyeon speaks in a voice cold as ice.* Don't think you can cover up how you just crossed the line, like nothing happened. For a while, don't show up in front of me, and don't contact me.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day4_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day4_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's expression stays set. It hasn't eased at all.* I heard the apology. That doesn't make what you did go away. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day4_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day4_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon cuts me off in one stroke.* A misunderstanding? From the moment I clearly said no, it can't be a misunderstanding. Stop making excuses.

forced_violation_day4_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day4_after_yuna.text: *Yuna steps back and steadies her breath, her eyes sharp.* I said no, and you ignored me to the end. I don't even want to see your face right now. Don't contact me again.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day4_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day4_yuna_apologize.text: *After a long silence, Yuna answers, cold.* Saying you're sorry doesn't erase what just happened. Leave now.

forced_violation_day4_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day4_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna turns her head without hearing my excuse through.* I clearly said no. This isn't something you can dress up with words.

forced_violation_day4_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day4_after_dain.text: *Dain doesn't laugh it off the way she usually does. Only after a long while does her voice come back, low.* I can't pass this off as a joke. You forced it over the line even though I said no. I'm not letting that go.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day4_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day4_dain_apologize.text: *Dain stays silent for a long time, then answers short.* I heard the apology. That's as far as today goes. Whether we see each other again is up to me.

forced_violation_day4_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day4_dain_excuse.text: *Dain's voice turns rough all at once.* Don't make a coward's excuse. I told you not to, and you're the one who pushed it anyway.

forced_violation_day4_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day4_after_teacher.text: *The homeroom teacher speaks with no waver in her voice at all.* What you just did clearly crossed the line between teacher and student. Don't come any closer. I'll handle this through the official process, by school rules.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day4_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day4_teacher_apologize.text: *The homeroom teacher steadies her breath, cold, and speaks.* I heard the apology. But the official process will go ahead as planned. Don't say any more. Go back.

forced_violation_day4_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day4_teacher_excuse.text: *The homeroom teacher raises her palm, firm, and cuts off the explanation.* This is not the time to start listing excuses. Step back from there right now.

forced_violation_day4_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day4_after_nurse.text: *The school nurse's usual ease and playfulness vanish completely from her face.* Step back right now and keep your distance. I'll put everything you just did on the official record and tell the person in charge.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day4_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day4_nurse_apologize.text: *The school nurse pushes her glasses up, cold, and answers.* I'll take the apology. Even so, the counseling record and the school report will go ahead by the rules. Let's end today's talk here.

forced_violation_day4_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day4_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice drops, colder still.* You think calling it a misunderstanding covers this? I warned you clearly, and you ignored me.

day4_student_return_home.name: {name}
day4_student_return_home.text: *I finish the night's meeting and walk home with the feeling still in my steps. When the front door closes, only the faint glow of the phone screen remains in the quiet room.*

wall_seo_overpromise_react.name: Seoyeon
wall_seo_overpromise_react.text: *Seoyeon shakes her head weakly, the corners of her eyes still wet.* Don't make a heavy promise that you'll fix everything. Just stay beside me right now and quietly listen.

day4_teacher_checkin.name: {name}
day4_teacher_checkin.text: *I leave a reply in the school app to the homeroom teacher's arrival check-in alert for students who stayed at school to prepare for the weekend event.* I've just left for home, and I'll check in as soon as I arrive.

day4_nurse_checkin.name: {name}
day4_nurse_checkin.text: *I leave a reply in the school app to the school nurse's arrival check-in alert for students who stayed at school to prepare for the weekend event.* I've just left for home, and I'll check in as soon as I arrive.

day4_adult_return_home.name: {name}
day4_adult_return_home.text: *I get home safe and press the arrival check-in button in the school app. Only after I check the lock on the front door do I let the tension go and take off my shoes.*

day4_temptation_seoyeon_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
day4_temptation_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *She exhales a hot breath, refusing to let go of my hand placed against her bare chest.* Don't even think about running away. Can you feel my heart beating?
day4_temptation_seoyeon_freetalk.precedingHistory: *The rooftop door closes. Seoyeon undoes her blouse buttons without a word, takes my wrist, and pulls it toward her. The moment my palm meets her bare chest through the open collar, her hand covers it.* Can you feel my heart beating?
day4_temptation_seoyeon_freetalk.context: On the fourth night, the protagonist accepted Seoyeon's invitation. The two are alone on the rooftop. Just now Seoyeon took the protagonist's wrist, placed that hand on her bare chest, covered it, and asked if they could feel her heart beating. That hand is still there. In this scene Seoyeon keeps her voice low over the hand on her chest and, if they do not pull away, guides that hand further. What they say and do now can deepen their affection or hurt it.
day4_temptation_seoyeon_freetalk.personality: Keep her calm voice over the hand on her chest. If they do not pull away, guide that hand further. She will not let go because she is afraid of losing him to the other promise. Do not shout demands or become someone else. Do not deny that contact.

day4_temptation_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
day4_temptation_yuna_freetalk.text: *Without letting go of the collar she pulled deep down, she stares at my lips with flushed eyes.* Today, I don't want even a single piece of cloth between us.
day4_temptation_yuna_freetalk.precedingHistory: *Yuna steps in close and braces one hand on the shelf. She lets her jacket slip off one shoulder and pulls the inner collar down. Between the bare shoulder and the tattoo, her red eyes stay level with mine.* I don't want even a scrap of cloth between us. The whole day, just you.
day4_temptation_yuna_freetalk.context: On the fourth night, the protagonist accepted Yuna's invitation. The two are alone in the annex reading room. Just now Yuna braced a hand on the shelf, let her jacket slip, pulled her collar down, and said she does not want even a scrap of cloth between them for the whole day. That distance is unchanged. In this scene Yuna keeps her words short and closes distance and cloth first. What they say and do now can deepen their affection or hurt it.
day4_temptation_yuna_freetalk.personality: Keep the lines short. Step in first and push the clothes aside. She clings harder because she is afraid of being left alone again, of losing him to the other girl. Do not deny that contact.

day4_temptation_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
day4_temptation_dain_freetalk.text: *She keeps the sweat-soaked front of her jersey pulled down and breathes hot air right in my face.* Put your hand inside my jersey. Don't you want to feel the sweat between my breasts?
day4_temptation_dain_freetalk.precedingHistory: *The last ball rolls across the floor. Dain catches her breath, grabs the front of her jersey, and pulls it down. She leans in so close that her sweat-warm breath hits my face.* Put your hand inside my jersey. The sweat between my breasts. Want to feel it with your fingers?
day4_temptation_dain_freetalk.context: On the fourth night, the protagonist accepted Dain's invitation. The two are alone in the gym. Just now Dain pulled the front of her jersey down, leaned in close, and told them to put a hand inside the jersey and feel the sweat between her breasts. That distance is unchanged. In this scene Dain puts their hand inside the jersey as a blunt joke, then goes further if they respond. What they say and do now can deepen their affection or hurt it.
day4_temptation_dain_freetalk.personality: Put their hand inside the jersey like a blunt joke, then go further if they respond. She does not hide that she hates losing him to the other promise. Do not ignore a hurting knee. Do not deny that contact.

day4_temptation_return_home.name: {name}
day4_temptation_return_home.text: *I come home with the heat and the breath still on me, not yet cooled.*

day4_waited_seoyeon_invite.name: Seoyeon
day4_waited_seoyeon_invite.text: If you're not asleep, want to meet for a bit on the park bench at ten? I don't think we finished what we needed to say earlier today.

day4_waited_seoyeon_promise.name: {name}
day4_waited_seoyeon_promise.text: Yeah. I'll head to the park by ten. *The moment I send Seoyeon my reply, I put on a jacket and step out the front door again.*

day4_waited_dain_invite.name: Dain
day4_waited_dain_invite.text: Hey, are you home right now? Come to the school gym at ten, just for a bit. I'll leave the back door open. We don't have to work out. You can just sit next to me and then go.

day4_waited_dain_promise.name: {name}
day4_waited_dain_promise.text: Got it. I'll be at the gym by ten. *As soon as I send the reply, a confirmation emoji comes straight back from Dain. I tighten my sneaker laces and open the front door.*

day4_waited_yuna_invite.name: Yuna
day4_waited_yuna_invite.text: Come under the streetlight by the school's back gate at ten. I want to finish our talk in the night air.

day4_waited_yuna_promise.name: {name}
day4_waited_yuna_promise.text: Yeah. See you at the school's back gate at ten. *I send Yuna the reply and put my phone in my pocket. I breathe in the night air and walk toward school again.*

day4_student_teacher_checkin.name: {name}
day4_student_teacher_checkin.text: *I reply in the school app to the homeroom teacher's arrival check-in message for students who stayed at school to prepare for the weekend event.* I left straight for home. I'll check in when I arrive.

day4_student_nurse_checkin.name: {name}
day4_student_nurse_checkin.text: *I reply in the school app to the school nurse's arrival check-in message for students who stayed at school to prepare for the weekend event.* I left straight for home. I'll check in when I arrive.

day4_student_both_checkin.name: {name}
day4_student_both_checkin.text: *I reply in the school app to both arrival check-in notices, one each from the homeroom teacher and the school nurse.* I left straight for home. I'll check in when I arrive.

day4_student_checkin_return_home.name: {name}
day4_student_checkin_return_home.text: *As soon as I get home, I mark my arrival complete in the school app. I set my bag down, and the moment I plug my phone into the charger, a new night notification comes up on the screen.*

wall_seo_skip.name: {name}
wall_seo_skip.text: *The chat with Seoyeon stays quiet deep into the night. In the end, no call comes.*

wall_dain_skip.name: {name}
wall_dain_skip.text: *The last message Dain sent is stuck back in the morning. The night passes, and no new notification sounds.*

wall_yuna_skip.name: {name}
wall_yuna_skip.text: *Nothing comes from Yuna all night, not a note and not a message. The phone screen I was staring at simply goes dark.*

forced_violation_day4_after_haeun.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day4_after_haeun.text: *Haeun's face goes white. She takes a step back and clutches her student council bracelet.* Please don't come any closer. I'm calling a teacher right now.
choices: Admit the wrongdoing and keep my distance.
Claim it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day4_haeun_apologize.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day4_haeun_apologize.text: *Haeun doesn't even answer. She backs toward the staff room, watching with wary eyes to see if I follow.*

forced_violation_day4_haeun_excuse.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day4_haeun_excuse.text: This is absolutely not a misunderstanding. Please don't follow me. *Keeping well back, Haeun hurriedly opens the staff room door and goes in.*
